body.name: \Gamma_n(\delta_n)
body.construction: For each \((c,\vartheta)\in\mathcal G_c\times\mathcal G_\vartheta\), use \(\mathcal B_n(c)\) and let \(\Pi_n(c,\vartheta)\) contain arrays \(\pi=(\pi_{k,d,y})\) of four nonnegative cells summing to one in every bin. Their two margins must equal bin averages of the certified outer H\"older sieves split at \(c\), satisfy the treatment-jump shell, and satisfy the null jump restriction for \(\vartheta\); the remaining association coordinate in every bin is free over its Fr\'echet interval. Put \(\widehat p_{k,d,y}(c)=N_{k,d,y}(c)/N_k(c)\) when \(N_k(c)>0\), and define \(\Delta_n(c,\vartheta)=\inf_{\pi\in\Pi_n(c,\vartheta)}\sum_{k:N_k(c)>0}N_k(c)\operatorname{KL}(\widehat p_k(c),\pi_k)\). Accept the grid pair when \(\Delta_n(c,\vartheta)\le\Gamma_n(\delta_n)\), where \(\Gamma_n(\delta_n)=3\sum_{k=1}^{K_n}\log(N_k(c)+1)+\log(|\mathcal G_c||\mathcal G_\vartheta|/\delta_n)\). Use the conventions \(0\log(0/q)=0\) and \(p\log(p/0)=+\infty\) for \(p>0\). Thus the joint four-cell deviance never divides by a covariance and remains defined on every singular association face.
